original: [22, Theorem 1] Let $T_{n}(H;k)$ denote the number of matrices in ${\mathcal{M}}_{n}({\mathbb{Z}};H)$ of rank $k$ . If $1\leq k<n$ , we have $T_{n}(H;k)\asymp H^{kn}\log H$ .
